full_prompt_en: A square high-detail science-fiction illustration fills the frame with the face and upper shoulder of a woman wearing complex metallic headgear. Her head turns slightly down and to the left, giving the viewer a three-quarter view of her smooth face. Wide amber-tinted goggles cover the eyes. The lenses have thick polished rims and layered internal reflections; the eyelids and lashes are still faintly visible through the warm glass. Her nose, cheek, and natural-colored lips remain exposed below the eyewear. A silver helmet wraps the forehead and temples, its surface broken into curved plates, screws, narrow seams, small mechanical arms, and a circular joint near the right side of the head. Fine wires descend beside the cheek and neck. At the lower right, a broad reflective armor plate catches a bright cool highlight, while darker ribbed material surrounds the shoulder on the left. The background is largely obscured by the tight crop; almost all visual space belongs to face, lens, metal, and cable. Light from above and the left moves across the helmet in sharp white gleams, then warms as it passes through the amber glass onto the skin. Silver-blue and graphite metals contrast with the golden lenses and pale peach face. The image is precise and glossy, but small etched lines, fasteners, and minute surface marks keep the mechanical parts from reading as a single smooth shell. The face is calm and inward-looking, providing a soft human counterpoint to the dense engineered framing. No readable labels are present. The composition relies on cropped curves and interlocking reflected shapes rather than a visible setting.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、高细节的科幻插画让一位女子的脸和上肩连同复杂金属头具填满画框。她的头略向左下转，观者看到柔和面部的四分之三侧角。宽阔琥珀色护目镜遮住眼睛，镜片有厚而光亮的边框及层层内部反射；眼睑和睫毛仍隐约透过暖色镜面可见。鼻子、脸颊和自然色嘴唇露在眼镜下方。银色头盔绕过前额与太阳穴，表面分割成弯曲甲片、螺钉、狭窄接缝、小型机械臂，以及靠右侧头部的圆形关节。细电线沿脸颊和颈侧垂下。右下角一片宽阔反光护甲接住明亮冷高光，左边肩部则被更暗的肋状材料围住。紧凑裁切几乎遮尽背景，视觉空间都交给脸、镜片、金属和线缆。来自上方和左侧的光在头盔上形成锐利白色闪光，穿过琥珀玻璃后变暖，落在皮肤上。银蓝和石墨色金属对照金色镜片与浅桃色面部。画面精确光洁，但小刻线、紧固件和微细表面痕迹让机械部件不至于成为一整块平滑壳体。面容平静而内收，为密集工程结构提供柔软的人性对照。没有可读标签。构图依赖被裁断的曲线和相扣的反射形体，而非可见场所。
style_prompt_en: Glossy science-fiction illustration interlocks polished curved metal, translucent warm lenses, and softly modeled organic surfaces at extreme close range. Cool silver, graphite, and pale blue highlights meet amber and peach tones in a dense but legible arrangement. Fine seams, tiny screws, etched lines, articulated joints, and trailing cables create mechanical rhythm around a quiet smooth center. Hard specular flashes travel along metal rims, while light through colored transparent material becomes warmer and more diffuse. Tight cropping turns partial circles and overlapping plates into the primary composition. Precision rendering preserves reflections and material differences without losing the gentle tonal transitions of skin or other matte surfaces.
style_prompt_zh: 光洁的科幻插画在极近距离将抛光曲面金属、透明暖色镜片和柔和塑形的有机表面互相扣合。冷银、石墨色与浅蓝高光在密集却清楚的结构中遇上琥珀和浅桃色。细接缝、微小螺钉、刻线、活动关节与垂落线缆在安静平滑的中心周围形成机械节奏。硬质镜面闪光沿金属边框滑行，透过有色透明材料的光则更暖、更柔。紧凑裁切使局部圆弧和重叠甲片成为主要构图。精密描绘保留反射与材料差异，也保留皮肤或其他哑光表面的细柔明暗过渡。
theme_en: A close view of a woman in mirrored mechanical headgear
theme_zh: 一位佩戴镜面机械头盔的女子近景
name: Hajime Sorayama
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
